Very Poor Experience with Ankita Pest Control, Mahim

I had a highly disappointing experience with Ankita Pest Control. There is a clear lack of coordination among the Booking staff, Sr. Technician and Pest Control Technicians.

We booked a yearly Termite control contract (1+3 services) through Senior Technician Nitin Shelar. However, when the team arrived, they brought Bed Bug treatment chemicals instead of the required Termite control materials. We had to spend considerable time contacting both the Senior technician and the Booking staff to resolve this issue.

Additionally, one technician attempted to leave the job midway after working for about an hour, stating he had another appointment. We again had to follow up multiple times with the Senior Technician over calls to ensure both Technicians continued the work as originally agreed. If only one Technician had continued, it would have taken several more hours to complete the job, which had already been delayed due to the initial confusion of Bed Bug treatment.

The entire experience with the Ankita Pest Control Staff was extremely frustrating and poorly managed.

Furthermore, despite committing to a 1+3 service contract, the invoice provided after full payment mentioned only 1+2 services, which is misleading and unacceptable.
